tip.benchNever: Not on the bench in the last {count} raids
tip.empty: Hover a raider to see details

requiredBuffs.label: Required buffs
requiredBuffs.tip: Buffs the raid template asks for.

mainSpec.label: Main spec
mainSpec.tip: Raiders on the spec they signed up with.

preferredCharacter.label: Preferred character
preferredCharacter.tip: Whoever lists several characters comes along with the first — a "can also bring" character costs this much.

fairness.label: Fairness
fairness.tip: Whoever sat on the bench last or often is more likely to come along. Only when fairness is on.

partyBuffs.label: Party buffs
partyBuffs.tip: Totems, auras and shouts in the group that need them.

wishes.label: Wishes
wishes.tip: "Happy to be with" in one group. Only when wishes are on.

avoid.label: Not together
avoid.tip: Penalty when a "not together" pair stands in the same group (parallel raids: in the same raid). Only when "not together" is on.

raidBuffs.label: Raid buffs
raidBuffs.tip: Every raid buff somebody in the raid brings.

status.changedSub: Raiders keep seeing the approved version until you approve again.
status.changedSubSince: Raiders keep seeing the approved version from {time} until you approve again.
status.draftSub: Raiders don't see anything yet. Only after approval does the setup appear on the web, in the event message and in the bot.
status.autoSub: Created by EventHelper at signup close. Check, adjust, approve.
status.autoSubAt: Created by EventHelper at signup close ({time}). Check, adjust, approve.

slot.lockedSub: A new proposal leaves this spot as it is. Click to unlock.
slot.lockSub: A new proposal should keep this spot.

summary.noRequired: No required buffs in the raid template.
summary.fairnessSub: Whoever sat on the bench last is more likely to come along in the next proposal.
summary.wishesSub: Raiders list in their profile whom they like to raid with. While this is on, the proposal puts such pairs into one group where it can. The default comes from the event or its raid template.
summary.wishesMetSub: "Happy to be with" pairs in the same group. Only visible to the organisers.
summary.wishesOffSub: Wishes are not considered for this event.

avoidSub.one: {count} pair of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. On: separate groups (separate raids when raids run in parallel). Nobody sees who named whom.
avoidSub.other: {count} pairs of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. On: separate groups (separate raids when raids run in parallel). Nobody sees who named whom.

summary.avoidTogetherSub: This many pairs still stand in the same group. "Propose again" separates them as far as it can.

askText.one: {count} pair of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. Should the proposal put them into separate groups? Who named whom stays hidden – you can switch it any time in the side column.
askText.other: {count} pairs of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. Should the proposal put them into separate groups? Who named whom stays hidden – you can switch it any time in the side column.

weightsModal.title: Weights
weightsModal.hint: Applies to the next proposal. Roles and raid size always come first.

explain.title: AI explanation
explain.hint: Only explains — it never changes the setup.
explain.noKey: Without an Anthropic key (Settings › Connections) there is no AI explanation.
explain.none: No explanation for this setup yet.

publishLine.postSub: Posts the approved setup to the event channel or updates the message there, and sends any DMs still missing. A draft is never posted.

pingText.label: Ping message — posted when you click "Ping everyone"
pingText.title: Ping message
pingText.tip: The text every placed raider gets pinged with — both on "Ping everyone" in the channel and automatically on the first post of the approved setup. Leave empty for the default text.

readOnly.notApproved: The setup has not been approved yet.

editor.approveAnywayText: The setup doesn't pass every check (roles, size or required buffs). After approval, raiders see it exactly as it is.
editor.placesSub: {count} of {size} spots filled · {bench} on the bench
editor.lockedSub: A new proposal keeps these spots.
editor.pickTarget: Pick a target — group, bench or raider · Esc
editor.sizeSub: Every group has 5 places, the raid's player count follows from that. Groups and bench change right away in the browser, applied when you leave the field or press Enter.
editor.sizeUnsavedTip: This number of groups has not been applied yet.
editor.compactSub: Narrow cards with one-line raiders, for small screens. Remembered in this browser.

moves.groupFull: Group {group} is full — drag onto a raider to swap.
moves.raidFull: The raid is full ({size}) — drag onto a raider to swap.

publish.offSub: DMs are turned on per category: Settings › Categories › Setup DMs.
publish.cancelledText: Cancelled — no setup in the channel
publish.cancelledSub: A cancelled event gets no setup posted and no DMs. A message already posted is marked as cancelled.
publish.draftNeverPosted: Raiders only see what is approved — a draft is never posted.
publish.editsExisting: The existing message is edited, not posted again.
publish.dmOnlyChanged: Only raiders whose spot changed since their last DM get a new one.
publish.notPostedSub: Posts the approved setup as its own message in the event channel.
publish.unchanged: {count} without a new DM — spot unchanged.
publish.outdated: The message still shows version {version} — "Post setup" updates it.
publish.reapproveSub: On re-approval the message is edited, not posted again.
